title: Labels and marks on a tab staff
description: The same score-wide furniture as 09 — rehearsal mark, section name, segno, fine and a metronome mark — on a part whose staffKind is "tab". Everything here lives on the GLOBAL measure, which is MNX's container for things that describe the bar rather than a staff: they carry a `location`, never a `staff`. So none of it is notation's to keep, and a tab reader needs it more than most — a section name and a D.S. are how you know where you are in the piece. Until this scenario existed the corpus had no document that was both tab-rendered and label-bearing, which is exactly why the tab layout drew none of them.
